what: Street-level stage in the full analysis, end to end: a DATUM node of its own (port 8791, own data dir, the node of nodes.datum.json without the seeded reference set), built with tsc into a separate directory and run with node; street-level comparison on (default), Panoramax only (no Mapillary key), cold street-level vector cache (DATUM_STREETLEVEL_CACHE pointed at an empty directory). Two 20-minute videos uploaded one after the other through POST /api/videos?fps=1&detail=standard&source=eingang as the console does; GET /api/public/info every 200 ms from the first upload to the last full fix.

machine.note: shared machine, load average 4.8-6.2 on 4 cores during the run (other agents at work): every time is an upper bound

HTTP latency over 2790 probes: median 1.3 ms, p95 7.0 ms, p99 35.6 ms, max 871.8 ms; the maximum fell into the quick stage of the first upload (gallery search and frame decoding on the main thread, before any street-level work); from quick to full fix of Paris (analysis, then the full stage with the street-level stage) max 261.7 ms, p99 22.3 ms.
